steps.note: Stirred in at no more than 35–40 % solids and kept under 65 °C, which would denature the whey proteins.

steps.name: hydrate
steps.note: Left with little or no stirring to hydrate and let the air out.

processing.text: The handbook describes these steps for recombined milk; reconstituted milk is the same without the added fat.
